title: ManifestDeclaration
description: The provider-side declaration a conforming provider MUST carry in its package manifest so the probe can be answered without loading code (RFC §4.3): the `comprehendo` key in package.json, `[tool.comprehendo]` in pyproject.toml, the gemspec metadata hash. This declaration is ADVISORY; the marker on the value is the source of truth at runtime, and if they disagree the marker wins. The endorsement keys of RFC §10.6 (`corpus`, `owners`) ride the same manifest key and validate here by virtue of the open-object rule, without this version of the spec having to name them.

version.description: The spec version this provider implements, e.g. "0.1".

level.description: The declared conformance level (RFC §3). An integer, not a string: the manifest form in the RFC is `level: 2`.
